docs.title: Omkar's Python Learning Journey
docs.text: Welcome! This is where I document what I’m learning as I go from Python beginner to project builder.

docs.title: Topics Covered So Far
docs.text:
• Variables, loops, and functions
  • Working with files
  • Data analysis with Pandas
  • Visualising data with Matplotlib
  • Using APIs (like yFinance)

docs.title: Projects in Progress
docs.text:
• Stock Returns Visualiser
  • News Headline Web Scraper
  • Portfolio Dashboard

docs.title: Why I'm Doing This
docs.text: I want to build strong Python skills, learn how to work with real data, and eventually build tools or dashboards I can use in finance, investing, and personal projects.
